title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 30 - Ebrahim Rezaei, a member of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission of the Iranian Parliament, made remarks on a TV talk show about Iran's nuclear plans, the first such remarks at least since the US- Israeli war against Iran began.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 30 - Ebrahim Rezaei, a member of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission of the Iranian Parliament, made remarks on a TV talk show about Iran's nuclear plans, the first such remarks at least since the US- Israeli war against Iran began."

"SOT1, Ebrahim Rezaei, a member of the National Security and Foreign Policy Commission of the Iranian Parliament: "Now, I don't want to say that we should start building nuclear bombs tomorrow morning; that has its own stakeholders, and someone like me might have an opinion on that as well. But what I am saying is that we must preserve our nuclear capabilities at the highest level, and this matter is very important. Meaning, we have now reached 60 percent enrichment. We must certainly upgrade this 60 percent enrichment to reach 90 percent as well.""

"SOT2: "If one day the country changes its decision, if one day another fatwa [religious decree] is actually issued, if one day the conclusion of the Islamic Republic system actually turns out differently, we must ensure that we have not lost our current achievements by then; by that day, our distance from a nuclear Iran will have been minimized.""

""
"SOT3 : "According to the enemy's own admission [referring to Trump's speech], if we had become a full-scale nuclear power today, I do not think we would have been subjected to their attacks. If we had become nuclear, they would have treated us differently. Now, despite all the damage they have sustained in fuel, energy, elections, and various economic sectors, they are putting all their strength into preventing Iran from becoming nuclear. The mere fact that the enemy is making such an effort to prevent us from becoming nuclear proves this; they themselves have advanced to the end of the nuclear issue [in achieving nuclear capability]. They know better than anyone that if we become nuclear power, they will have to speak to us in a completely different language and manner.""

"SOT4 : "From the 12-day war until today, no International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) inspector has visited our sensitive nuclear sites, neither Fordow, nor Natanz, nor Isfahan, the sites that were damaged in the war and that the enemy is actually afraid of.""

"SOT5 : "The 12-day war and the 40-day war showed that the IAEA's role was actually similar to that of Western intelligence services; it provided them with our information, the data of our scientists, and our centers. Now, as the enemy exerts pressure for renewed inspections and the return of the Agency's inspectors to the country, the real goal is to update its nuclear information database. Since the date we stopped allowing them access, they no longer know what is happening in our nuclear centers, and this is what puts pressure on them.
